summary: Hunan AikeWei Semiconductor Equipment Co., Ltd. is a national high-tech enterprise founded in 2015, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of semiconductor equipment. The company provides end-to-end equipment solutions for integrated circuits, discrete devices, 5G communications, optoelectronic devices, and sensors, supporting both research and mass production.
